LanguageData.Gun_FAMAS_G1_RWP.label: FAMAS G1
LanguageData.Gun_FAMAS_G1_RWP.description: The FAMAS G1 is a compact, French 5.56mm bullpup assault rifle known for its high rate of fire and reliable performance. It excels in close to mid-range combat situations, providing superior burst damage with its three-round burst feature. Lightweight and easy to maneuver, it's ideal for rapid engagements, though its accuracy may drop at long distances.
